evidence: Live fetch of webstore.iec.ch/en/publication/26359 confirmed: Title 'Failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA and FMECA)', Standard Number IEC 60812, Edition 3.0, Publication Date 2018-08-10; page states this edition 'cancels and replaces the second edition published in 2006'.
note: THE defining international standard for FMEA/FMECA, named zero times across 585 round-1+critic entries despite STPA (a competing method) scoring 6 hits.
